definition: The file extension of Microsoft Money data files, which MoneyMatter can import. Copy it exactly, with the dot.
Holdings-table column: average cost per share or unit (crypto too), i.e. cost basis divided by quantity held. Abbreviated for a narrow column; use a short form readers recognise.
ukNote: If the column is too narrow: «Сер. ціна» (next to the «Ціна» column).

definition: A bank, cash, credit, loan or investment account holding money – not a user login account.
A user's login account: on MoneyMatter ("Delete your account") or at another service (Google, SimpleFIN Bridge). Not a financial account holding money; use a different word if your language has one.
The kind of financial account: cash, current account, credit card, savings, loan, investment, crypto, vehicle, etc. Not a transaction category.
The currency an account is kept in; its transactions' main amounts are in this currency. Not the base currency (used for totals) and not a transaction's original (foreign) currency.
A user-made folder of accounts that organizes the accounts list and sidebar; bank connections can create one. Never affects syncing. Not a transaction group.
ukNote: Standalone «група» where the context is clear.

definition: In automations: a change applied to each matching transaction (set category, set payee, add tags, set note). Elsewhere generic: menus, "This action can't be undone".
Status: in use now, e.g. a bank connection whose access hasn't expired, a running recurring payment or a paid-up plan.
ukNote: Agree with the noun it describes; standalone group label «Активні». With a bare count, write «Активних: {count}».

definition: A tag reminder type: notifies the user when there are transactions with that tag, checked on the chosen schedule. Not a security or login check.
Set a manually tracked account's balance to its real value; MoneyMatter records the difference as a balance adjustment transaction.
The person who runs a MoneyMatter server (instance); also the admin-only Settings section with system tools such as price sync.
ukNote: Section title «Панель адміністратора».

definition: Artificial intelligence: MoneyMatter's AI features (categorization, reading statements and invoices) and the AI assistants that connect to it.
ukNote: Latin script everywhere. As a leading modifier it takes a hyphen: «AI-категоризація», «AI-помічник», «AI-модель».

definition: An AI chat app, such as Claude or ChatGPT, that the user connects to MoneyMatter to ask about their data. The landing-page help chatbot is also called 'the assistant'.
ukNote: The landing-page help chatbot: just «помічник».

definition: The feature where AI picks categories for uncategorized transactions: automatically after a bank sync or run by hand from Optimizations. Its feature-list name is "Transaction Categorization".
ukNote: Hyphenated compound in sentence case. The feature-list name 'Transaction Categorization' (common.aiFeatures.categorization.name) = «Категоризація транзакцій».

definition: A saved entry in Settings → AI → AI models: a provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio or a custom OpenAI-compatible server), a model name and an API key (optional for local servers), under a name the user picks. Each AI feature can run on one. Not MoneyMatter AI, the model included in the plan.
ukNote: Follows the AI decision (hyphenated leading modifier). Tab and section title: «AI-моделі». A bare "model" stays «модель».

definition: Free crypto tokens received without buying them; recorded as an investment transaction with price 0.
Another name, often raw bank or merchant text, linked to a payee so different spellings resolve to the same payee. Not a person's nickname.
Environment variable a self-hosting admin sets to list the web addresses allowed to reach the server. Code name: copy it exactly.
A loan's planned repayment timeline from its original principal, rate and term ("Original schedule"), used to estimate interest. Not depreciation or a recurring payment's schedule.
ukNote: 'Original schedule' = «Початковий графік» («первоначальний» is a Russianism). амортизація stays for vehicle depreciation; a recurring payment's schedule is «розклад».

definition: A tag reminder type: notifies the user once spending on that tag goes over a set amount; also that amount itself.
Name of the app section (sidebar item) that holds the reports, such as Cash Flow and Net Worth History; in prose, those reports in general.
Startup-investing platform where syndicates raise venture deals (SPVs); given as an example venture platform. Brand name: do not translate.
The AI company that makes Claude; one of the AI providers a user can add an API key for. Brand name: do not translate.
Application programming interface: the technical access point MoneyMatter uses to reach a bank, data provider or AI service ('API credentials'). Keep the acronym.
A secret key the user enters so MoneyMatter can use an outside service's API for them: an AI provider (Anthropic, OpenAI...) or a bank data provider.
ukNote: Same hyphen for Monobank's 'API token': «API-токен».

definition: Monobank's personal read-only access token, which the user copies from Monobank and pastes in to connect. Not an API key and not SimpleFIN's setup token.
ukNote: Hyphen as in «API-ключ» (see the API key decision).

definition: A software application: MoneyMatter itself, an AI assistant or other program connected to your data, or another finance app you import from.
A software app: the one the user registers in the Enable Banking portal (with an Application ID and private key), or a third-party app asking for OAuth access. Not a request or form.
ukNote: MoneyMatter's own label and prose use «ID застосунку». Enable Banking's bold lead-in labels ('Application name:', 'Application ID:') are copied bare; «» only when its label is quoted inside a sentence («Create Application»).

definition: Run an automation rule on existing matching transactions, after reviewing the matches, instead of only on new ones.
Annual percentage rate: the yearly interest rate on a loan, shown per loan and as an average. Use your language's usual term for an annual interest rate.
Hide an account, loan or budget from active lists, pickers and the sidebar while keeping its history; can be undone. Archiving an account also stops its bank sync.
Status of an account, loan or budget that was archived: hidden from active lists and pickers but kept with all its history. Not deleted.
ukNote: Badge «Архівовано»; section title «Архівовані».

definition: Open-banking acronym for the bank that holds the account; a field label on Enable Banking's own setup page, quoted as-is. Keep the acronym.
Anything of positive value the user owns (money in accounts, investments, crypto, vehicles) that counts toward net worth. Opposite of liability. Not one portfolio holding.
ukNote: Usually plural «активи» in net-worth labels. «актив» also translates holding (a security in a portfolio); context separates them.

definition: The kind of security, stocks or crypto, used to match symbols to securities in an investment import and to filter symbol search.
A file (receipt, invoice, photo, PDF) attached to a transaction.
Import review status: MoneyMatter linked this row (e.g. an account or category from the file) to an existing item on its own.
A recurring-payment option that creates the transaction automatically on each due date, instead of matching an imported one.
A user-defined rule that automatically edits or categorizes transactions when conditions match.
ukNote: Automation screens also call one automation a rule: «правило».

definition: Imported transactions older than an account's latest existing transaction; they fill in past history without changing its current balance.
ukNote: Column label: «Дозавантажені рядки».

definition: A downloadable zip file with all of the user's MoneyMatter data that can be restored later. Not a "backup login method" (a spare way to sign in).
ukNote: The process/tab «Backup & restore»: «Резервне копіювання та відновлення».

definition: The amount of money in an account or portfolio at a point in time; can be negative. For a loan see outstanding balance. Not a balance-sheet or equilibrium word.
ukNote: An account or portfolio balance is always «баланс», never «залишок». A loan's balance: «залишок боргу» (see outstanding balance).

definition: A transaction that corrects an account's or portfolio's cash balance to its real value; not real income, spending or a contribution. A loan's correction is an edit of its outstanding balance.
ukNote: Short badge «Коригування»; attributive «коригувальна транзакція». A loan's correction: «коригування залишку боргу».

definition: The date and amount a loan's outstanding balance is fixed at. Payments dated earlier are kept as history and don't reduce the balance.
ukNote: Label «Balance as of»: «Залишок станом на».

definition: Name of the dashboard widget and chart showing total balance over time, with spike markers and a projection of planned entries.

The middle of three model tiers in the "Which model fits?" guide: a mid-size model that stays accurate over long text and files (e.g. for statement parsing). Inserted as {tier} in "{tier} model is enough".
ukNote: Masculine, agreeing with the implied «рівень»: «Достатньо рівня «{tier}»».

definition: A user's link to a bank or data provider (Monobank, Enable Banking, Lunch Flow, SimpleFIN, Walutomat) that accounts sync through. Not a network or MCP (AI assistant) connection.
ukNote: Standalone «підключення» where the context is clear; a network connection stays «з'єднання» (uk.md §5).

definition: Payment type (next to card, cash, mobile payment): the transaction was made by bank transfer, incoming or outgoing. A method label, not MoneyMatter's transfer between the user's own accounts.
Round-half-to-even rounding (IEEE 754) used for currency conversions: a half goes to the nearest even digit. Use your language's standard name for it.
A FIRE variant where the user leaves full-time work for part-time or lower-paid work that covers some expenses while savings cover the rest. Keep the name untranslated.
A transaction's amount converted into the user's base currency, used for totals, statistics and budget limits. Also called "ref amount". Not the original (foreign-currency) amount.
The single reference currency all of a user's amounts are converted to and totalled in.

The web address of the OpenAI-compatible server an AI model sends requests to, usually ending in /v1 (e.g. https://example.com/v1). OpenAI, Anthropic and Google models use their official address and take none.
ukNote: Field label: «Базовий URL». URL stays in Latin script (see URL).

definition: Badge on a feature or integration that works but is still being tested (e.g. Enable Banking). Not the finance 'beta' (volatility measure).
Bank Identifier Code (SWIFT code), shown next to each bank in the Enable Banking bank list. Usually kept as the Latin acronym.
One of the three recurring payment types, next to Subscription and Installment: a regular bill such as utilities or rent. Not a bank account and not an invoice.
ukNote: uk.md §5: where it could be read as account, write «рахунок до сплати». Standalone titles use «Рахунки до сплати» (dashboard.widgets.subscriptions.titleBills). «Рахунок/Рахунки» only for type chips, options and filters next to Підписки/Розстрочки. 'Subscriptions & Bills' = «Підписки та рахунки».

definition: The period between two expected payments of a recurring payment, matching its frequency (e.g. monthly).
The Stripe-hosted page, opened with "Manage billing", where users switch plan or billing period, update their payment method, see invoices, or cancel or renew their plan.
ukNote: Button 'Manage billing' = «Керувати оплатою».

definition: Every two weeks, not twice a week. A recurring-payment frequency and a Cash Flow chart grouping ('Bi-weekly').
The public feedback board (an external site) where users post feature requests, vote on ideas and see what is planned. Not the dashboard.
ukNote: 'feature board' = «дошка пропозицій» (locative: «на нашій дошці пропозицій»), never «дошка фіч».

definition: Account category for balances of bonus or loyalty points, such as rewards or cashback points. Not a salary bonus.
ukNote: Adjective agreeing with «рахунок», like the other account categories (Страховий, Інвестиційний).

definition: Said of a bank: to post a transaction to the account, which ends its pending state ("booked transactions"). Never "reserve"; only the noun "booking" in order fields means a reservation.
ukNote: «Банк ще не провів цю транзакцію»; a pending bank transaction is «в обробці». 'Booking' as a reservation = «бронювання».

definition: To record a recurring payment as a real transaction in an account, done by MoneyMatter on the due date or when the user marks it paid. Never "reserve".
ukNote: Same verb as record payment and auto-record (записати, «Автозапис»); see the record payment decision.

definition: The brokerage firm that holds the user's investments; its statements and CSV exports can be imported into a portfolio.
The period-based plan: lines with assigned amounts per period, rollover and Ready to Assign. Not a tracker (the date-range spending watcher).
The optional spending cap set for a tracker; spending is shown against it as a percentage.
ukNote: Standalone 'Limit' = «Ліміт».

definition: Company that makes the Wallet budgeting app; MoneyMatter imports its exports ('Wallet (BudgetBakers)'). Brand name: do not translate.
Changing category, payee, tags or note on many selected transactions at once.
Investment transaction type: a purchase of units of a security. Used as a type label, so a noun form fits best.
Button label that dismisses a dialog or stops an action without saving. Also withdraws a sent invitation or ends the MoneyMatter plan; use your usual verb per sense. Not the Cancel investment type.
Investment transaction type for a cancelled or reversed trade, next to Buy, Sell, Dividend and Fee. A noun label (a cancellation), not the Cancel button.
A possible recurring payment that MoneyMatter detects in the user's transactions (Discover); it can be added, linked or dismissed. Not a person.
A payee's primary name, shown everywhere in the app. Its aliases are other merchant texts that map to the same payee.
Venture event type: the fund or syndicate asks the investor to pay in part of the capital they committed.
Carried interest: the share of a venture deal's profit the GP (deal lead) takes above the hurdle, usually a percentage. Venture jargon: do not translate.
ukNote: Kept in Latin script. Lowercase «carry» mid-phrase, capital only at the start of a label or sentence: «Carry %», «GP carry», «Перевизначити автоматичний carry».

definition: Physical money (notes and coins): an account category and a transaction payment type. Not a portfolio's cash balance and not a trade's cash leg.
Money not invested in securities: a portfolio's uninvested money per currency ("Cash Balances"), or savings kept as money. Not physical banknotes.
ukNote: Compounds use грошовий: cash balance = «грошовий баланс», cash transaction = «грошова транзакція».

definition: Portfolio transaction columns ("Cash", "Cash fees"): the money actually paid or received for a trade, in its settlement currency. Not banknotes and not the portfolio's cash balance.
The uninvested money a portfolio holds in each currency, changed by deposits, withdrawals, trades and currency exchanges.
Money moving in and out: income minus expenses over a period (Cash Flow report and widget), or the money movement recorded for a venture event.
A portfolio transaction that changes only its cash balance: deposit, withdrawal, transfer or currency exchange. Not a buy or sell, and not a payment in banknotes.
Assigning categories to transactions, automatically by AI, an automation or a payee's default category, or by hand. For the AI feature name see AI categorization.
ukNote: The AI feature name is «AI-категоризація» (see AI categorization). Uncategorized = «без категорії» / «некатегоризований».

definition: A label used to classify transactions by type of spending or income, e.g. Groceries.
A report section listing spending or income per category for the selected period. "Breakdown" means split by category, not a failure.
A tracker type that automatically tracks every transaction in the chosen categories, as opposed to a manual tracker with hand-picked transactions.
ukNote: Type label 'Category-based' = «За категоріями».

definition: Money taken from the user: a recurring payment, a MoneyMatter plan payment ("No further charges") or an amount charged in another currency. Not an electric charge or the "Charges, Fees" category.
ukNote: Verb 'charged' (from the user's account) = списано; a fee charged by a fund or syndicate = стягує. 'No charge' = «Безкоштовно»; seeded category 'Charges, Fees' = «Збори, комісії».

definition: Seeded expense subcategory "Charges, Fees" under Financial expenses: bank and service fees. Use a natural local category name. Not a payment; "No charge" means free.
OpenAI's AI chat assistant, one of the apps users can connect to MoneyMatter. Brand name: do not translate.
The Stripe-hosted payment page where the user enters payment details to start a paid MoneyMatter plan; local currency and tax are shown there. Plan changes happen in the billing portal.
ukNote: «сторінка оплати» where the page is opened or shown; settings.planBilling.checkoutFailed = «Не вдалося відкрити сторінку оплати». A discount 'applied at checkout': «під час оформлення оплати».

definition: Anthropic's AI assistant and model family (e.g. Haiku, Sonnet); users can connect it to MoneyMatter or pick its models for AI features. Brand name: do not translate.
A holding whose units have all been sold, listed separately from open holdings in a portfolio.
A FIRE variant where the user stops adding new savings once invested assets are projected to grow into a full FIRE number by retirement age. Keep the name untranslated.
Environment variable a self-hosting admin sets to turn on crypto search. Code name: copy it exactly.
Seeded Investments subcategory for collectibles such as art, coins or stamps. Not debt collection.
Status of an installment plan whose scheduled payments are all paid. Also used for a finished import or sync.
ukNote: Status label form; as an adjective agreeing with a noun: завершений.

definition: One rule an automation checks on a transaction (field, operator, value); the automation acts only when its conditions match.
Status of a planned transaction once the real transaction happened, recorded by the user or matched from the bank. Opposite of planned or unconfirmed.
ukNote: Status label form; as an adjective: підтверджений; the confirm action = підтвердити. «Не підтверджено» / «непідтверджені» only for planned transactions. A bank transaction not yet booked (Pending) is «в обробці» (see pending); fix transactions.pending.label «Непідтверджено».

definition: To link MoneyMatter to an outside service: mainly a bank or data provider so accounts sync, also an AI assistant, AI server or sign-in method. "Connect the currency" means adding it to your list.
ukNote: reconnect = перепідключити. 'Connect refunds' (link sense) = прив'язати.

definition: A link between MoneyMatter and a bank or data provider through which accounts and transactions sync. Not a network or internet connection.
ukNote: uk.md §5: bank connection = банківське підключення, never з'єднання; a network connection stays з'єднання («Перевірте з'єднання»).

definition: Name used inside instructions for the part of a bank connection page that shows how long its authorization (consent) stays valid, with a Reconnect button. Translate it the same way in all 3 strings.
The integration a user adds in an AI assistant's settings (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) to reach MoneyMatter's MCP server. Not a bank connection. The assistant's own button labels stay in English.
ukNote: Claude's and ChatGPT's own UI labels («Connectors», «Add connector», «Add custom connector», «Add») stay in English inside «» (shared.md §10); fix settings.aiIntegrations.actions.addConnector, addCustomConnector, add. In prose: «конектор».

definition: The Settings → AI tab where the user connects AI assistants such as Claude or ChatGPT to their MoneyMatter data through the MCP server, and reviews or revokes active connectors. Not a bank integration.
ukNote: Tab label settings.ai.tabs.connectedApps. oauth.authorize.footer must quote the exact path: «Налаштування → AI → Конектори (MCP)». Claude's and ChatGPT's own «Connectors» label stays in English (see connector).

definition: The permission the user gives at their bank for MoneyMatter to read their accounts through an open-banking provider; it expires and is renewed by reconnecting.
AI model info label ('Context:'): the model's context window, the most text (in tokens) it can take in at once. Not general 'context'.
Money the user moves from an account into an investment portfolio (Investment Contributions report). In budget sharing, "contribute" means adding one's own transactions. Not a donation.
ukNote: Budget-sharing 'contribute' = додавати (прив'язувати) свої транзакції, never внесок; fix pages.budgetDetails.sharing.description. 'Contribute on Crowdin' = «Долучитися на Crowdin».

definition: The total amount paid to acquire a holding or venture stake, used to calculate gains and returns.
The secret details that let MoneyMatter access a provider's API: API key, token, application ID or private key. Not the user's MoneyMatter login.
A card that borrows against a credit limit: an account category and a transaction payment type. Not a debit card.
The maximum a credit account (e.g. a credit card) lets the user borrow; it can optionally be subtracted from balances in statistics.
The share of the user's total credit limits currently in use across accounts, shown in a dashboard widget.
Online platform where community volunteers translate MoneyMatter. Brand name: do not translate.
Cryptocurrency: an asset class in portfolios and symbol search, and an account category. Use your usual word for cryptocurrency.
Comma-separated values: a plain-text table file format used for imports and exports. Keep the acronym.
A unit of money (e.g. USD, EUR) an account, transaction or price is denominated in.
Converting a portfolio's cash from one currency to another: the "Exchange Currency" action and a cash transaction type. Not a stock or crypto exchange.
ukNote: The button 'Exchange Currency' (portfolioDetail.actions.exchangeCurrency) = «Обміняти валюту» (uk.md §1 infinitive); the noun (dialog title, cash-transaction type) stays «Обмін валют». Failure toast: «Не вдалося обміняти валюту».

definition: The short sign shown for a currency (e.g. $, €, ₴) instead of its three-letter code. Not a ticker symbol.
Account category for an everyday bank account used for payments and card spending (a checking account). 'Current' does not mean 'present-day'.
An exchange rate the user sets by hand in Settings → Currencies, overriding the live market rate; shown alone as the badge "Custom". Not the "Custom rate" vehicle depreciation preset.
ukNote: Badge 'Custom' = «Власний»; 'Live' = «Автоматичний». The vehicle depreciation preset 'Custom rate' = «Власна ставка».

definition: Free-text notes the user writes to guide how AI categorizes their transactions (e.g. which merchant goes to which category). Needs one of the user's own AI models; they don't apply when MoneyMatter AI runs categorization.
On an invoice, the party the invoice is billed to (the buyer). Not the merchant who issued it; the app matches it against a transaction's payee.
Section that groups destructive, hard-to-undo actions: in Settings (wipe all data, delete the MoneyMatter login) and on a financial account's page (delete or unlink it).
MoneyMatter's home page, with widgets summarizing accounts, balances and spending. Not a third-party provider's dashboard (e.g. Walutomat's).
ukNote: Sidebar item: «Головна». A provider's dashboard (Walutomat, Enable Banking, Bridge) = панель.

definition: One venture investment (e.g. a stake via an SPV or fund) tracked with its own terms, events and metrics. Not a trade, discount or bargain.
ukNote: venture deal = венчурна угода (uk.md §5).

definition: Money the user owes. In the Net Worth report, debt types are loans, credit cards and overdrafts, and what is owed on them counts as liabilities.
A preset category: the user's fallback for transactions nothing else categorized (AI categorization targets these), or the category set on a payee, which in "enforce" mode always wins over AI.
Tags set on a payee that MoneyMatter adds automatically to new transactions linked to that payee. Not the starter tags seeded for new users.
ukNote: Follows the default category decision (за замовчуванням). The payee field 'Auto-apply tags' = «Автоматично застосовувати теги».

definition: In the Cash Flow chart, the part of spending and portfolio contributions that income didn't cover, so it came out of existing account balances.
Button label that removes an item such as a transaction or account. Some items (portfolios, venture deals and platforms) go to the trash first and can be restored.
The character that separates columns in a CSV file (comma, semicolon, tab). MoneyMatter detects it and shows it in the column-mapping step of an import.
Try-before-signup mode: a temporary session with sample data and no real account. Not the free trial of a paid plan.
ukNote: demo mode = демо-режим.

definition: Cash added to a portfolio's cash balance from outside; a cash-transaction type, opposite of withdrawal. In recurring-payment text, incoming money (income). Not a bank savings deposit.
ukNote: Recurring-payments sense ('scheduled deposit') = дохід.

definition: The modeled loss of a vehicle's value over time, from a preset curve or a custom annual rate. Not loan amortization (paying a loan down), and its rate is not a loan interest rate.
ukNote: Loan 'amortization (schedule/formula)' is a different concept: «графік погашення» / «формула погашення», not амортизація.

definition: The account, portfolio or loan that receives the money in a transfer. Opposite of source account. Lunch Flow's 'API Destinations' is its own UI label: keep it in English.
ukNote: destination portfolio = цільовий портфель; source account = вихідний рахунок. Form label 'To account' = «На рахунок». Standalone 'destination' = цільовий рахунок, never призначення, which reads as payment purpose.

definition: In the pivot report: what the totals (expenses or income) are broken down by: category, payee, tag… The measure is the value added up. Not a physical size.
Option for a portfolio cash deposit or withdrawal: record the cash straight on the portfolio, with no account on the other side. The other option is Transfer.
Status of an item or setting the user switched off, e.g. an automation or live exchange-rate updates. Not "Paused" (on hold, or an automation paused because something it used was deleted).
ukNote: Status label: «Вимкнено»; filter and plural text: вимкнені. 'Paused' = призупинено.

definition: End a connection: a bank integration, an OAuth login, a connected AI app or a currency added to the user's list. Detaching one account from its bank connection is also called disconnect (= unlink).
ukNote: Detaching one account from its bank connection (= unlink): «відв'язати».

definition: Button and panel ('Discover Subscriptions') that scans transaction history for likely recurring payments and lists them as candidates to add or dismiss.
ukNote: Panel title 'Discover Subscriptions' = «Пошук регулярних платежів»; other strings refer to the button as the «Знайти» section.

definition: Reject a suggestion MoneyMatter found, such as a detected recurring-payment candidate or a transfer match, so it is not offered again. Not just closing a window.
Close a status screen or overlay (import delete, base currency change, backup restore) while the job may still run. Nothing is cancelled or rejected.
Hide the dashboard Quick Start guide for good ('Dismiss permanently'). Nothing is deleted or rejected.
The currency one portfolio's value and stats are shown in, converted at the current exchange rate. A per-portfolio view setting; not the base currency.
Venture event: cash returned to the investor from a deal, e.g. proceeds of a partial exit; carry is deducted from it. Not a statistical distribution or an allocation.
A cash payment from a held security (stock or ETF) paid out to the investor; also an investment transaction type.
ukNote: Type labels are singular like their siblings (Купівля, Продаж, Комісія, Податок): «Дивіденд».

definition: Container software. The app mentions it for a self-hosted MoneyMatter that runs in Docker next to a local AI model server. Brand name: do not translate.
Distributions to paid-in capital: a venture ratio of cash returned to the investor divided by the capital paid in. Keep the acronym.
Date a recurring payment is due; reminders, 'due this week' and auto-recording use it. Not the date actually paid. In the shared date picker ('Due date' header) it just means Date.
ukNote: 'on the due date' reads naturally as «у день оплати». In the shared date picker (common.dateSelector.dueDate) just «Дата». A loan's length is «строк» (see term).

definition: Name of MoneyMatter's lifetime plan for early users, listed with Essential, Plus and Premium. A plan name: one form everywhere, never an ordinary phrase.
ukNote: Plan names stay in Latin script (uk.md §5): «план Early Adopter». The status badge is a separate entry (early adopter).

definition: Status badge on the plan and billing page for users on a lifetime plan granted to early supporters. Describes the user; the plan name is a separate entry.
Do not translate – product/brand name (open banking connectivity provider). "EnableBanking" is the same name.

In AI model errors: the OpenAI-compatible server (e.g. Ollama, LM Studio or a custom one) that an AI model reaches at its base URL. In two other server errors (loan and vehicle account creation, category budgets) it means an API route instead.
A single transaction as a record ('This entry is the refund'); a planned entry is a scheduled one not yet recorded. In import mapping, an existing account, category or tag. Not an entry fee.
One-time fee paid to a venture platform or syndicate lead when joining a deal, usually a percentage of the principal. Not a ledger entry.
Name of MoneyMatter's entry paid plan, next to Plus and Premium ('Included in the Essential plan'); one form everywhere. 'Essential expenses' (a seeded tag) is the ordinary adjective.
ukNote: Kept in Latin script: «план Essential» (uk.md §5). The seeded tag 'Essential expenses' = «Необхідні витрати».

definition: Exchange-traded fund: a fund that trades on a stock exchange like a single stock. One of the security types a portfolio can hold. Keep the acronym.
Microsoft's spreadsheet app. Here it names the .xlsx file option in data export. Brand name: do not translate.
Converting cash from one currency to another inside a portfolio, recorded as its own transaction. Not a transfer, and not a stock or crypto exchange.
ukNote: Button: «Обміняти»; feature and type label: «Обмін валют».

definition: A stock or crypto trading platform (e.g. Binance) whose transaction-history export can be imported into a portfolio. Not the currency-exchange action or an exchange rate.
The ratio used to convert an amount from one currency into another.
ukNote: Bare «курс» is fine where context is clear (курс 1:1, курс на {date}). The 'FX rate' column header = «Курс обміну», or bare «Курс» where space is tight; 'FX' is not a do-not-translate item.

definition: Leave chosen categories or transaction types out of one widget, filter or report. Nothing is deleted or archived, and it can be undone.
Per-account or per-loan setting that leaves it out of totals, net worth, charts and reports while it stays active and visible. Not archiving.
Venture event: a full or partial sale of the stake in a deal that returns value to the investor. Not leaving a screen or mode.
ukNote: Partial exit = частковий вихід; Fully exited = повністю закритий; Expected exit = очікуваний вихід.

definition: Badge on an upcoming planned transaction: money the user expects to move on that date, not yet recorded. Also 'Expected amount' of a recurring payment. Not a bill that is due.
ukNote: Standalone status badge: «Очікується» (records.upcomingSection.expectedBadge).

definition: A transaction that decreases available funds (spending) – opposite of income.
Status of a bank connection whose consent or session has ended, so syncing stops until the user reconnects; 'Expiring soon' warns ahead. Also used for login sessions and invitations.
ukNote: Standalone status label: «Закінчився» (agrees with рахунок / термін дії); Expiring soon = «Скоро закінчиться». In sentences: «Термін дії … сплив»; expiring: «Термін дії … спливає через …». Session sense: «сесія закінчилася».

definition: A file of data saved out of an app: MoneyMatter's own data export in Settings, or a bank's or other app's export file that the user imports.
The account as a connected bank or provider reports it, linked to a MoneyMatter account. Its synced transactions can't be deleted by hand and some fields are read-only. Not a manual account.
Optional transaction field for the user's own outside reference, such as an order, invoice or booking number. Not the External ID a provider assigns, and not the external link (URL) field.
AI reads an uploaded file or pasted text and pulls out transactions (dates, amounts, buys and sells) for the user to review before import.
A FIRE variant built around a generous, above-average retirement budget. Keep the name untranslated.
A cost charged for a transaction, service or investment trade, e.g. a commission; also an investment transaction type.
Venture event type recording a fee charged against a deal, e.g. a management fee.
Financial Independence, Retire Early: saving and investing aggressively to quit paid work well before typical retirement age. Keep the acronym.
The invested amount a user needs to retire under the FIRE strategy: annual spending divided by the safe withdrawal rate.
ukNote: «FIRE» stays in Latin script; only «число» is translated.

definition: The financial institution transaction ID field in OFX/QFX files, used to detect repeated transactions. Technical field name, keep as is.
Full-screen view of the transactions table that hides the rest of the interface.
How often a recurring payment or a tag reminder repeats, from daily or weekly up to annual.
Venture deal status: the whole stake has been exited and the capital returned, so the deal is closed. Compare 'Partial exit'.
ukNote: Status label «Повністю закритий», next to «Частковий вихід».

definition: AI model capability badge 'Functions': function calling, i.e. the model can call tools or functions. Not app features.
In Venture: a pooled investment fund run by a fund manager or GP; 'fund deals' are investments made through one. Not 'funds' meaning money ('Transfer funds').
ukNote: funds meaning money ('Transfer funds') = кошти.

definition: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, the US accounting standards, cited next to IFRS. Keep the acronym unless your language has an established one.
Google's family of AI models, offered as an AI provider option. Brand name: do not translate.
Google's family of open AI models, suggested as a low-cost model for AI categorization. Brand name: do not translate.
Settings section that controls how financial data is calculated and shown app-wide (transfers, pending transactions, savings, defaults). The usual 'General' settings tab.
ukNote: Settings nav item and page title: «Загальні».

definition: Catch-all account type for accounts that fit no other type (listed with Cash, Current account, Credit card, Saving account). Not 'Current account'; describes the account.
Code-hosting site where MoneyMatter publishes its releases ('View on GitHub'). Brand name: do not translate.
Used as a sign-in method ('Sign in with Google') and as an AI provider (Gemini models). Brand name: do not translate.
ukNote: Sign in with Google = «увійти через Google»; Google sign-in = «вхід через Google».

definition: General partner: the syndicate lead or fund manager who runs a venture deal and takes carry; the investors are LPs (limited partners). Keep the acronym.
ukNote: Spelled out once in hints as «генеральний партнер (GP)».

definition: OpenAI's family of AI models, named in AI provider labels and model hints ('OpenAI (GPT)', 'GPT-OSS'). Do not translate model names such as Llama, Gemma or Claude Haiku either.
Venture distribution or exit amount before the GP's carry is deducted; what remains after carry is the LP net amount.
Net Worth Drivers label for net-worth change from the market (price moves plus dividends, minus fees), paired with "Saved". A past-participle label, not the noun "growth"; prose reuses the label.
ukNote: Quote it in prose as «Зросло», next to «Заощаджено». 'Grown total' = «Загальне зростання»; growth (noun) = зростання.

definition: Target in the Net Worth Drivers report: the portfolio size at which market growth, not the user's own saving, adds most of the monthly gain.
Home equity line of credit: a loan type, a revolving credit line secured by a home. Keep the acronym.
Badge on a portfolio the user turned off, and the name shown for a transfer's other account when the user can't see it. Not deleted or archived.
A specific security owned within a portfolio (a position), with quantity and cost basis.
One user's sharing circle: people the owner invites get access to every account the owner has, now and added later. Access is one-way; a user can also join other people's households.
Minimum return investors (LPs) must earn on a venture deal before the GP starts taking carry, set as a percentage. A finance term, not an obstacle.
ukNote: Kept in Latin script like carry, GP, LP.

definition: Identifier of a record, as in "External ID", "Batch ID", "Connection ID" or "Application ID". Keep "ID".
Bank sync status: no sync is running or queued right now. Not an error, and not an inactive (disabled) connection.
ukNote: Not «У черзі» (Queued) and not «Неактивний» (Inactive connection).

definition: International Financial Reporting Standards, cited as recommending the rounding method used for currency conversion. Use your language's established acronym if it has one.
ukNote: Established uk acronym (Міжнародні стандарти фінансової звітності). GAAP stays in Latin: «МСФЗ/GAAP».

definition: Raw merchant text the user has blocked from automatically creating or matching a payee. It can still be linked to a payee by hand. Not a hidden or deleted payee.
Bringing accounts, transactions, categories and tags into MoneyMatter from a file (CSV, OFX, QFX, statement), another app's export or a bank connection. Also a verb.
ukNote: Verb: імпортувати.

definition: Everything created by one import run, with a batch ID so it can be found or deleted as one unit. In "YC batch" it means a startup-accelerator cohort instead.
ukNote: Standalone «пакет»; Batch ID = «ID пакета».

definition: Page listing past imports (import batches): what accounts and transactions each one created, with an option to delete an import.
Bank connection status: the connection was deactivated (e.g. after repeated sign-in failures or while reconnecting) and does not sync. Opposite of Active.

Plan sense: part of the user's MoneyMatter plan at no extra cost, as in "MoneyMatter AI · included", "the included model" and "Included in the Plus plan". Elsewhere ("included in backups", "in balance totals") it is ordinary wording.
ukNote: «включений» also reads as "switched on", which clashes with the feature toggles around it. Build around the verb: «MoneyMatter AI, що входить у ваш план»; option label «MoneyMatter AI · входить у план». billing.planRequired.essential and .plus still say «Включено в план …»: align to «Входить у план …».

definition: A transaction that increases available funds (earnings) – opposite of expense. Not an investment return or yield.
ukNote: Investment return = дохідність, never дохід.

definition: The yearly rise in prices. The investment calculator uses it to show real (inflation-adjusted) values next to nominal ones.
The balance an account starts with when it is created or imported, before any recorded transactions. Also the starting amount in the investment projection.
ukNote: A loan's opening balance is debt still owed: «початковий залишок боргу» (dialogs.loanPayment.preAnchorHint), not початковий баланс.

definition: Venture event type that records the first capital the user puts into a deal, next to capital call, distribution and exit.
One of three recurring-payment types, next to Subscription and Bill: a purchase paid off in a fixed number of scheduled payments. Also one of those payments.
ukNote: One payment of it: платіж ('Number of installments' = «Кількість платежів»).

definition: One running MoneyMatter server installation, such as a self-hosted one, with its own administrator and settings. Not 'for instance'.
A connection to an external bank or provider used to import accounts and transactions.
Cost of borrowing: money charged on a loan's outstanding balance ('Interest paid', 'Interest left'). Seeded categories also use it for interest earned. Not curiosity or a stake.
ukNote: Plural noun in this sense: відсотки, відсотків.

definition: A loan's yearly interest rate as a percentage, entered as 'Interest rate (APR %)'. Closely related to APR.
Fails validation or is not accepted: a password, file, amount, date, ID, imported row, API key, token or bank credential; also a key's status badge. Not a person with a disability.
ukNote: Key, token, credential, connection or row status = недійсний. Wrong user input (password, amount, date or file format) = неправильний, like 'Incorrect password' = «Неправильний пароль».

definition: Report of the money the user moved into portfolios over time; one contribution is one such transfer. Balance corrections don't count. Nav label: Contributions.
ukNote: Report name, plural. Nav label: «Внески»; one contribution = внесок.

definition: Analytics tool that projects how a portfolio could grow from a starting balance and monthly contributions over a chosen number of years.
A buy, sell, dividend, fee, tax or other record on a holding in a portfolio. Not a regular account transaction.
App section with the user's portfolios of stocks, ETFs, crypto and other securities. Not the Venture section for private deals, which needs a different word.
ukNote: Section name, plural. Venture section = Венчур, never Інвестиції.

definition: A request, usually sent by email, for another person to get shared access to an account, budget or household. It can be pending, accepted, declined, resent or cancelled.
ukNote: Verb invite = запросити.

definition: Shareable link that invites another person to join the user's household or shared accounts and budgets.
A document requesting payment (PDF or image), issued to or by the user, that is attached to a transaction. A receipt is a different word. Not a recurring Bill, not a financial account.
ukNote: Receipt = чек. Seeded category names (defaultCategories.*) may use a natural local name.

definition: AI feature that reads an uploaded invoice or receipt (total, date, merchant) and finds the transaction it belongs to. Started with "Attach invoice".
Internal rate of return: the annualized return of a venture deal, taking the timing of its cash flows into account. Keep the acronym.
International Organization for Standardization. Here only in 'ISO date format' (ISO 8601): year first, YYYY-MM-DD. Keep the acronym.
Image file format accepted for transaction attachments and invoices, listed with PNG, WebP and PDF. Keep as is.
Data file format, offered for data export and, next to CSV, for admin price uploads. Keep as is.
A FIRE variant built around a minimal, low-spending retirement budget. Keep the name untranslated.
Give up your own access to a household you joined, or to an account or budget someone shared with you. Not "leave blank" and not time off.
ukNote: Leave share? = «Вийти зі спільного доступу?»; leaving a household = вийти із сім'ї, never «залишити». Different senses: Leave blank = «залишити порожнім», Leave feedback = «Залишити відгук».

definition: The user's full record of transactions in MoneyMatter; used to say an imported row is already recorded. Not a separate accounting book.
The bank or institution a loan was taken from.
Money the user owes (loans, credit balances), subtracted from assets to get net worth. Usually plural. Not legal responsibility.
Shown after a plan name ("{plan} · lifetime") when the plan is granted for life (Early Adopter): no renewal, no card on file. Not a purchase option or billing cycle.
ukNote: Adverb after the plan name: «{plan} · довічно». Related 'for life' = назавжди.

definition: The lowest of three model tiers in the "Which model fits?" guide: a small, fast, cheap model is enough (e.g. for categorization). Inserted as {tier} in "{tier} model is enough". Not the Light theme.
ukNote: Masculine, agreeing with the implied «рівень»: «Достатньо рівня «{tier}»». The Light theme is «Світла».

definition: Connect records: a transaction to a portfolio, deal, loan, budget or recurring payment; two transactions as a transfer; an account to a bank; an imported value to an existing one. Not a web link.
ukNote: Noun: прив'язка; linked: прив'язаний; opposite: відв'язати. A web link = посилання. In import wizards, linking an imported account, category or tag to an existing one is the map action: 'Link to existing' = «Зіставити з наявним».

definition: Mark an income or expense as the refund of an earlier transaction so statistics net them out. Opposite: Unlink refund.
ukNote: Noun (refund link): прив'язка повернення; opposite: відв'язати повернення.

definition: Of an exchange rate: updated automatically from market data, as opposed to a custom rate the user sets. Not a live broadcast.
ukNote: Live update = автоматичне оновлення. Live (market) rates = актуальні ринкові курси.

definition: Meta's family of open AI models, used in the sample AI model names "OpenRouter Llama" and "Local Llama". Not the animal. Do not translate.
Desktop app that runs AI models locally and serves them through an OpenAI-compatible API; one of the provider options when adding an AI model. Brand name: do not translate.
A borrowed sum tracked with its own balance, payments and payoff schedule.
ukNote: Loan types use кредит: Студентський кредит (loans.types.student), like Автокредит, Споживчий кредит.

definition: An expense or transfer that pays down a loan and reduces its outstanding balance, recorded on the loan's page or linked to it.
The kind of loan: Mortgage, Vehicle (auto loan), Student, Personal (consumer loan), Business, Medical, HELOC, Other. The type names appear alone as labels.
ukNote: Type labels use кредит: Автокредит, Споживчий кредит, Бізнес-кредит, Медичний кредит, Іпотека. Student loan = студентський кредит; loans.types.student «Студентська позика», loans.dialog.createDescription and loans.empty.description break loan = кредит.

definition: Optional place attached to a transaction, taken from the device or picked on an OpenStreetMap map; a payee can have a default location.
ukNote: A point picked on the map: «місце» («Виберіть місце», «Відкрити місце на карті»).

definition: A way to sign in to MoneyMatter: password, a linked OAuth account (e.g. Google) or a passkey. Managed in Security settings.
Limited partner: an investor who puts capital into a venture fund or syndicate but does not manage it; usually the user. Opposite of GP. Keep the acronym.
ukNote: Prose may gloss it once: «інвестори (LP)». For 'LP net' see LP net.

definition: Amount paid to the investor (LP) from a venture event after the GP's carry is taken off the gross amount. Keep "LP" as is; "net" may be translated.
ukNote: Pairs with Gross = «Брутто» in the same event table. Label 'LP net amount' = «Сума нетто LP» (like «Сума брутто»). LP stays in Latin script.

definition: Bank-data provider that syncs transactions from banks worldwide through an API key. Brand name: do not translate; write "Lunch Flow" even where the source says "LunchFlow".
In a split transaction: the transaction's own category, which keeps any amount not assigned to a split. Not a parent category.
A tracked vehicle's manufacturer or brand (e.g. Toyota), entered next to model and trim. Not the verb.
Highest sharing permission on a shared account or budget: Write plus managing who else has access, but not deleting it. Also "Full access"/"Manager". Elsewhere "manage" is the plain verb.
ukNote: Permission-level label, a noun like its siblings «Перегляд» and «Редагування» (see read-only). 'Full access' = «Повний доступ»; the badge 'Manager' = «Може керувати», like «Може редагувати транзакції». Avoid управління only for this level: management fee = комісія за управління. Plain verb = керувати; the Payees tab 'Manage' = «Керування».

definition: Annual fee a venture syndicate or fund charges on a deal, as a percentage. Stored for the record only; not applied to events automatically.
An account the user creates and updates by hand, not linked to a bank connection. Some strings call it a "system account"; that does not mean an account the system created.
ukNote: 'system account', 'manual account' and 'manually managed account' are one concept; «рахунок з ручним керуванням» is a fine longer form in prose. Not the 'built into the app' sense of системна категорія.

definition: Budget type the user adds transactions to by hand. Not a category budget, which tracks transactions automatically by category.
In import wizards: match file columns, or imported account, category and tag values, to MoneyMatter fields or existing records. The source also says "link" here. Not a geographic map.
ukNote: Noun (mapping) = зіставлення. 'Link to existing' = «Зіставити з наявним». The Wallet import step 'Resolve' does the same job.

definition: Record a due recurring-payment period as paid so its schedule moves on. "Just mark as paid" does this without creating a transaction.
A holding's current worth at the latest market price (quantity × price). Not the cost basis, which is what the user paid.
A transaction or record found to fit another: one a rule's conditions hit, one suggested for a recurring payment or invoice, or a possible import duplicate. Likely/Weak match: detection confidence.
To link a transaction or imported value to the recurring payment, transfer or record it belongs to (by rules, AI or name). Rules, filters and 'X doesn't match Y' use the plain verb.
ukNote: Plain 'X doesn't match Y' (passwords, columns) stays збігатися; a rule's or filter's conditions: відповідати.

definition: A condition (field, operator, value) on a recurring payment that links bank transactions to it. In automations, 'first matching rule wins' just means the rule whose conditions fit.
ukNote: In automations.subtitle 'first matching rule' is not this term: «перше правило, що збіглося».

definition: Merchant category code: a standard card-network code for the type of business. 'MCC rule' is a categorization source. Usually kept as the acronym.
ukNote: In compounds put the acronym after the noun: «правило MCC» (or «MCC-правило»), not «MCC правило».

definition: Model Context Protocol: the open standard that lets AI assistants such as Claude or ChatGPT connect to the user's MoneyMatter data through its MCP server. Do not translate.
ukNote: MCP server = «сервер MCP» (settings.aiIntegrations.mcpServer.title); align the one «MCP-сервера» (settings.planBilling.tiers.essential.features.mcp).

definition: Pivot report control that picks which value the table adds up: Expenses or Income. Not a unit of measurement.
A person with shared access to an account, budget or household, as opposed to its owner.
ukNote: Household member: always «член сім'ї» (household = сім'я), never a bare член.

definition: The raw business name from bank or invoice text, used by automations and to detect payees. Not payee, the cleaned-up counterparty.
Combine two records into one: two payees (transactions and aliases move to the one kept), or an imported item into an existing holding or planned transaction.
Discontinued Microsoft personal-finance desktop app whose .mny files can be imported. "Your Money file" and "MS Money" mean this product, not money. Do not translate.
ukNote: Money file = «файл Money».

definition: Distance a tracked vehicle has been driven (odometer reading). The unit is not fixed and can be kilometres.
Lowest monthly loan payment the lender requires; an optional loan field that can be estimated from principal, rate and term. Not the user's planned payment.

The AI model (e.g. Gemini Flash, Claude Haiku) that runs an AI feature such as categorization or statement parsing: the model name saved in one of the user's AI models, or the one MoneyMatter AI uses. Not a vehicle model.
A tracked vehicle's model name (e.g. Corolla), entered next to make and trim. Not an AI model, and not "Depreciation model" (the method that computes a vehicle's loss of value).
Do not translate – product/brand name.

The AI model included in the user's MoneyMatter plan, run on MoneyMatter's own API key. Features use it when the user picks it, or by default when they have no AI models of their own. Usage limits apply, and not every plan includes it. Brand name: do not translate.
ukNote: "MoneyMatter AI · included" = «MoneyMatter AI · входить у план» (see included).

definition: Do not translate – product/brand name (Ukrainian digital bank).
A loan secured by real estate. Appears as a loan type, an account category and a seeded Housing subcategory.
Net asset value: the current value of the user's stake in a venture deal as reported by the fund or platform; a "NAV update" event records a new value. Keep the acronym.
Venture event that records a new net asset value (NAV) for a deal without any money moving. Keep NAV as the acronym.
Status for an item the user must act on, such as an import row that needs a choice or a bank connection that needs reconnecting.
Label for income minus expenses of a budget, transaction group or selection; can be negative, not an account balance. In venture 'LP net' it means after the GP's carry.
ukNote: Here сальдо means inflow minus outflow, never an account's balance. Compounds keep чистий: чистий потік, чисті заощадження, чистий дохід.

definition: Money in minus money out for a period or for one payee; negative when more went out. Shown in the cash-flow chart and payee stats.
In the investment calculator: average monthly income minus expenses, the same idea as net savings. Not after-tax income and not profit.
Income minus expenses for a period: what the user saved. Negative when spending exceeds income.
Everything the user owns (cash, accounts, investments, vehicles, venture deals) minus everything owed (loans and other debts).
Analytics report that splits net-worth change into Saved (income minus spending) and Grown (market returns on holdings).
Analytics report charting assets, liabilities and net worth over time, filterable by asset and debt type.
Free of cost: the user pays nothing (e.g. to vote on the roadmap for a coming-soon plan). Not a payment and not a fee.
Not adjusted for inflation: the projected amount in future money. Opposite of 'real' (inflation-adjusted) in the investment calculator. Not par or face value.
The free-text memo on a transaction, often the bank's description; automations and matching rules search or set it. Also Notes on deals, events, recurring payments. Not a 'Note:' remark.
Windows' built-in text editor, named in the Enable Banking setup steps. Use the name Windows shows in your language.
Open standard for signing in with another service (e.g. Google) or authorizing a bank or app connection without sharing a password. Do not translate.
OAuth permission that lets a connected AI app keep access between sessions without asking the user again. Not access without internet.
Open Financial Exchange: a bank-statement file format MoneyMatter can import. File format name: do not translate.
Tool for running AI models locally; one of the provider options when adding an AI model. Brand name: do not translate.
AI company behind GPT; one of the AI providers users can pick for AI features. 'OpenAI-compatible' means a server that speaks OpenAI's API. Brand name: do not translate.

Describes an AI server that speaks OpenAI's API (e.g. Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter), so MoneyMatter can reach it at its base URL. The provider option "Custom (OpenAI-compatible)" adds any such server as an AI model.
ukNote: Place it after the noun: «сервер, сумісний з OpenAI». Provider option: «Власний (сумісний з OpenAI)».

definition: Hosted gateway to many AI models; one of the provider options when adding an AI model. Brand name: do not translate.
Open map service that supplies map tiles and address search for the transaction location picker. Brand name: do not translate.
App section with cleanup tools for existing data: transfer matching, AI categorization, and running an automation over past transactions.
ukNote: The sidebar item and page title use the singular «Оптимізація».

definition: A purchase from a shop or service, as in the order number or order page kept with a transaction. Not a sequence.
The sequence items are arranged or run in, e.g. automation rules or file columns. Not a purchase.
A transaction's amount in the foreign currency it was actually paid in, when that differs from the account's currency. Not the base amount. In refund linking: the original transaction's amount.
A one-sided transfer to or from money outside the user's tracked accounts; for a venture event, cash recorded with no linked transaction. Not the Wallet product.
Venture deal status: the investment is still held, not exited or written off. On loan screens a bare "Outstanding" is the debt still owed instead (see outstanding balance).
ukNote: Venture status label, next to «Частковий вихід», «Повністю закритий», «Списаний». A loan's 'Outstanding' is the debt: «Залишок».

definition: The amount still owed on a loan, reduced by the payments linked to it. Loan screens also label it Balance or Outstanding. Not money in an account.
ukNote: Short column or summary label in loan screens: «Залишок». uk.md §5.

definition: Account type that lets the balance go below zero; to overdraw is to spend more than an account holds.
Status of a scheduled or recurring payment whose due date has passed without it being paid or recorded.
ukNote: Status badge: «Прострочено».

definition: The user who owns a shared account, budget or household and decides who else gets access. Opposite of member.
Profit and loss: the total gain or loss on a venture deal so far. Keep the acronym.
Status of a recurring-payment period whose payment is recorded or marked as paid. Not 'paid' as in not free (a paid service).
ukNote: Status label: «Сплачено».

definition: Loan status: the debt is fully repaid and nothing is left to pay.
ukNote: Status badge: «Погашено». The 'Closed' date label stays «Закрито».

definition: The category a subcategory sits under in the category tree.
Venture deal status: some money has come back or part was written down, but the deal still has value left.
A sign-in credential kept on the user's device or security key (fingerprint, face, PIN) that replaces typing a password.
Status of a recurring payment, automation or MoneyMatter plan that is stopped for now and can be resumed. Automations pause when an item they use is deleted.
ukNote: Status label: «Призупинено».

definition: The app's cleaned-up counterparty of a transaction, whether paid or paying: one word for both directions. Not merchant (raw bank or invoice text).
ukNote: «отримувач платежу» is fine for a standalone label or title (uk.md §5).

definition: MoneyMatter automatically creating and matching payees from the merchant text (optionally the description) of synced bank transactions. Configured in the Settings tab of the Payees page.
The card or other means Stripe charges for the user's MoneyMatter plan ('Update payment method'). Not a transaction's payment type (cash, card, etc.).
One due occurrence in a recurring payment's schedule; it can be marked paid, skipped or reverted to unpaid. Often just 'period'. Not a report date range.
ukNote: Bare 'Period' in planned.subscriptions.periods.*: «період».

definition: The due dates a recurring payment follows; each date is a payment period the user marks paid or skips. Without one, the item only detects matching transactions. Not a loan's amortization schedule.
ukNote: Standalone 'Schedule' in the recurring-payment editor = «розклад». A loan's amortization schedule is a separate entry: «графік погашення»; 'Original schedule' = «Початковий графік», never первоначальний.

definition: Transaction field under 'More options' for how it was paid: cash, bank transfer, credit or debit card, mobile payment, voucher, web payment. Not the plan's payment method.
The moment a loan's balance reaches zero, as in 'Payoff date' and 'Payoff projection'. Not a reward or result. 'Paid off' is the finished state.
ukNote: Follows the paid off decision: Payoff date = «Дата погашення»; Payoff projection = «Прогноз погашення». Current strings say закриття (дата закриття, прогноз закриття).

definition: File format name (Portable Document Format), used for bank statements, invoices and attachments. Keep as is.
Text file format for the RSA private key used by the Enable Banking and Walutomat connections. Keep as is.
Transaction status: the bank reported the transaction but has not booked it yet, so it doesn't affect the balance. Not 'planned' (entered ahead by the user).
ukNote: Status label: «В обробці». «Не підтверджено» belongs to planned transactions (see the other pending entry).

definition: Invitation status: an invitation to share an account, budget or household was sent but not yet accepted or declined.
ukNote: Heading: «Запрошення в очікуванні»; short badge: «Очікує».

definition: Describes planned transactions not yet confirmed as having happened ('pending planned transactions'), so they are not in the balance. Not a bank-pending transaction or an invitation.
An access right granted to someone: a share's level (read, write, manage) or what a connected AI app may do with your data.
ukNote: 'Access level' label: «Рівень доступу».

definition: Loan type label, shown alone in the loan type list: a personal (unsecured consumer) loan. Not the 'Personal' settings group.
ukNote: The label stands alone, so write the full loan-type name, like Автокредит, Бізнес-кредит.

definition: Name of the settings group with the user's own preferences (appearance, language, security, plan). Its pair is the Workspace group. Not the personal loan type.
Name of the Pivot report: a table that breaks spending or income down by category, payee or tag across time periods. Not a turn or change of direction.
ukNote: As in зведена таблиця (pivot table).

definition: The user's MoneyMatter tier: the paid Essential, Plus and Premium plans, or the lifetime Early Adopter plan. Not a planned transaction or an installment plan, which some strings also call 'plan'.
ukNote: Plan names stay in Latin script: «план Plus».

definition: Settings section where the user picks a MoneyMatter plan and manages payment method and invoices through Stripe. 'Billing' here means paying for the plan.
Transaction status: an expense or income entered ahead of time; it doesn't change the balance until confirmed. Not 'pending' (bank hasn't booked it).
ukNote: planned transaction = запланована транзакція; status label «Заплановано», filter/section title «Заплановані». A loan's 'Planned payment' is a different term (планований платіж).

definition: Roadmap sense: a feature or plan MoneyMatter intends to build but hasn't released yet, e.g. the Premium plan. Not a scheduled transaction.
ukNote: Status label: «Заплановано».

definition: Name of the sidebar section that groups Recurring Payments and Budgets. Not the planned-transaction status, so the word should not agree with 'transactions'.
ukNote: Neuter used as a noun; sidebar item, keep it short.

definition: A loan's target monthly payment set by the user, used to project payoff. Not the lender's minimum payment and not a planned transaction.
In Venture: the syndicate, fund manager or GP you invest through; its default fees pre-fill new deals. Not a software platform.
Name of a MoneyMatter paid plan ('Included in the Plus plan'). One form everywhere. Not the word 'plus' (added to), which also appears in strings.
ukNote: «план Plus», «Перейдіть на Plus».

definition: Image file format, accepted for transaction attachments and invoices. Keep as is.
A collection of investment holdings (stocks, ETFs, crypto) tracked together as one unit.
Moving cash between an account and a portfolio, or between two portfolios. Tracked separately from a transfer between two accounts.
ukNote: Directional labels: «Переказ з портфеля», «Переказ з рахунку», «На портфель» (like «На рахунок»). Where the direction matters, name it: «переказ з рахунку на портфель».

definition: The kind of investment portfolio: Investment, Retirement, Savings or Other. The type names appear alone as labels and describe the portfolio.
ukNote: Type names agree with «портфель»: Інвестиційний, Пенсійний, Накопичувальний, Інший.

definition: Name of a MoneyMatter paid plan, announced but not yet released. One form everywhere.
ukNote: «план Premium».

definition: Loan amount excluding interest: the sum first borrowed ('Original principal') or the part of a payment that repays it, as opposed to interest. Not a person in charge.
ukNote: Where the loan context is unclear: «основна сума боргу». Original principal = «Початкова сума».

definition: In Venture: the cash you commit to a deal, excluding platform fees; entry fees are calculated from it. Not a borrowed amount.
Secret RSA key file (PEM) the user creates to connect Enable Banking or Walutomat. MoneyMatter stores it encrypted and uses it to sign requests.
ukNote: Always «приватний ключ», also in the Enable Banking instruction steps (the MoneyMatter field is «Приватний ключ»).

definition: The balance expected on a date after adding planned transactions to the current balance. Compact spots show 'Projected {amount}'.
ukNote: Compact 'Projected {amount}' / '{amount} projected': «Прогноз {amount}».

definition: A third-party service MoneyMatter connects to: a bank-data provider (e.g. Enable Banking), an AI provider (e.g. OpenAI) or a sign-in provider (Google). "Credit card provider" means the card issuer.
ukNote: 'Credit card provider' = емітент кредитної картки.

definition: EU Payment Services Directive 2, the open-banking regulation Enable Banking uses to reach banks. Keep as is.
The shareable half of an RSA key pair. The user uploads it to Walutomat; the private key stays secret and is entered in MoneyMatter.
ukNote: key pair = пара ключів; private key = приватний ключ.

definition: Date-range shortcut typed into the date field (Q1–Q4 quarters, H1/H2 half-years). The field reads English only, so keep it as is. In 'Try: …' hints translate only 'Try:'.
ukNote: In 'Try: …' hints the months (Jan) stay in English too; only 'Try:' becomes «Спробуйте:». Outside the hints months are translated (Січ, Квіт).

definition: Quicken's variant of the OFX file format, imported alongside OFX as a bank statement. Keep as is.
Status: waiting in line to start or be applied, e.g. a bank sync, a file import, or a category move not yet saved. Not 'planned'.
ukNote: Standalone label: «У черзі». After a vowel: «в черзі» («переміщення в черзі», «додано в чергу»); after a consonant: «у черзі» («переміщень у черзі»).

definition: Name of the onboarding checklist on the dashboard that walks new users through setup tasks. One form everywhere.
ukNote: Quick Start guide = посібник «Швидкий старт».

definition: A cap on how many requests a service (an AI provider, a bank API) accepts in a period; going over it blocks requests for a while. 'Rate' is request frequency, not an exchange or interest rate.
ukNote: Prose may say «без обмежень» (no rate limits).

definition: Access that lets someone view data but not change it: a share permission ("Read", "Read-only", "View only") or your data after your plan ends. Also API tokens and bank-synced fields.
ukNote: Level label 'Read': «Перегляд»; 'Read-only' / 'View only': «Лише перегляд»; in a sentence: «лише для перегляду». API tokens, MCP data access and bank-synced fields: «лише для читання» is fine; the avoid list applies to share-level labels only.

definition: Adjusted for inflation, as opposed to nominal (e.g. 'Real final value'). Elsewhere 'real' just means actual, e.g. a real transaction vs a planned one.
Profit or loss locked in by selling a holding; can be negative. Opposite of unrealized gain on holdings still owned.
Move items to another owner before deleting: a category's transactions to another category, or loan payments to another account. Not assigning a person or role.
Repeating a bank provider's login and consent after access expired, keeping the existing bank connection. The same step as 'reconnect'.
A proof-of-purchase document (shop slip, e-receipt image or PDF) attached to a transaction; AI can match it to one. Different from an invoice: strings list both, so use two words.
The person an account or budget is shared with (the invitee), as opposed to the owner. Not a payee, the other party of a transaction.
ukNote: As a role label next to «Власник», use «Учасник» (like Member in budgets).

definition: Bank-connection feature that finds and merges duplicate transactions created by overlapping syncs. Not matching a balance against a bank statement.
Restore a broken connection so syncing resumes: re-authorize an expired bank or AI connection, or retest an AI model that needs attention. "Reconnect this account" in unlink texts means relink.
ukNote: Noun: перепідключення. Linking an unlinked account to its bank connection again: «знову прив'язати» (see relink).

definition: Log in MoneyMatter that a recurring or loan payment was made, by marking the period paid or creating a transaction. 'Record' means enter, not save audio.
Describes a payment or income that repeats on a schedule, as tracked in Recurring Payments. Covers income too, not only expenses.
A scheduled repeating payment or income (subscription, bill or installment). The feature is "Recurring Payments", also named "Scheduled payments": one translation for both names.
ukNote: Feature/section name, also for 'Scheduled payments': «Регулярні платежі» (uk.md §5).

definition: A transaction that returns money from a prior expense or income, linked back to it. Also a verb ('refunds', 'refunded by'). Not an investment return.
ukNote: As a verb: повертати («Повертає транзакцію»); 'Refunded by' = «Повернено».

definition: Exact name of the transactions file in YNAB's budget export, which the user uploads. Keep it character for character; 'Register' here is not a verb or a sign-up.
Link an existing account to its bank connection's account again, keeping its transactions. Not Reconnect (renews the whole connection), though "reconnect this account" in unlink texts means this.
ukNote: Link/Unlink = Прив'язати/Відв'язати; Reconnect (the whole bank connection) = Перепідключити. 'Reconnect this account' in the unlink texts = «знову прив'язати рахунок». 're-link' in payee texts (a sync attaching a transaction to a payee again) = «прив'язати знову».

definition: A notification MoneyMatter sends before a recurring payment is due, or from a tag reminder rule (spending on a tag passes a limit, or a tag is used).
Automatic start of the next paid period of the user's MoneyMatter plan ('Renews on {date}'). To renew after cancelling means switching auto-renewal back on.
ukNote: Verb: поновити / поновлюється. After a cancellation, 'Renew' = «відновити підписку».

definition: Import step where each account, category or tag in the file is linked to an existing one, created new or skipped; 'resolved' counts decided rows. Not a hostname lookup or fixing an issue.
ukNote: Counter 'resolved' = «вирішено». Other importers call the same step 'Map' (зіставити).

definition: Bring something back: a portfolio from trash, an archived loan, or all data from a backup file (which replaces the current data).
ukNote: Noun: відновлення («Відновлення з резервної копії»).

definition: Investment gain or yield, often a percentage ("Annual return", "Total Return"). Not a refund and not income. The verb "return" (an SPV returns capital) is ordinary.
ukNote: Total return = загальна дохідність; Annual return = річна дохідність (uk.md §5).

definition: Undo a payment period's paid or skipped status so it is unpaid again, optionally unlinking or deleting its transaction. Not Cancel (close a dialog).
ukNote: Title: «Скинути статус періоду»; toast: «Статус періоду скинуто».

definition: End access you granted: a shared budget member, a connected AI app, a sign-in session. Not 'leave' (ending your own access) and not Cancel.
ukNote: revoke access = відкликати доступ.

definition: MoneyMatter's public list of planned features, where users vote on and suggest what gets built next. Not a navigation map.
Public-key encryption standard. 'RSA private key' and 'RSA key pair' are the key files a user creates for Enable Banking and Walutomat. Keep as is.
ukNote: Put the acronym after the noun: «приватний ключ RSA», «ключ RSA», «пара ключів RSA».

definition: A set of conditions that triggers an action: one automation, a matching rule of a recurring payment, or a categorization source (MCC rule, payee rule, user rule).
One execution of AI categorization over a batch of transactions, started by hand or after a sync or import. Past runs are kept in a history.
The US stock market index, cited in the investment calculator as a benchmark for average yearly return. Do not translate.
The percentage of a retirement portfolio withdrawn in the first year (then inflation-adjusted) that is expected to last through retirement without running out.
ukNote: The abbreviation SWR stays in Latin script as «SWR». Distinct from the "withdrawal" entry (portfolio cash-out action, «зняття»); this is the FIRE planning rate.

definition: The lowest value, as a % of purchase price, that a vehicle's modeled depreciation can reach: its salvage value. Not the current depreciated (book) value.
Button label that stores the current form's changes. Not saving money, as in 'Save up to 20%' on the plan billing page.
ukNote: Money sense ('Save up to {percent}%', settings.planBilling.saveUpTo) = заощаджувати.

definition: Label for money set aside (income minus spending): part of net-worth change next to "Grown", and the cash-flow savings figure. Prose reuses the label. Not "stored", as in a saved file.
ukNote: «Збережено» only for saved forms, files and settings. In prose, quote the label: «Заощаджено».

definition: Account category for a savings or deposit account: money set aside, not used for daily payments. Listed next to Current account and Credit card.
Money saved over a period: income minus spending (Cash Flow, Trends, Net Worth Drivers). Also a seeded category. Not a savings account or the Savings portfolio type.
ukNote: The label 'Saved' (money) = «Заощаджено», not «Збережено».

definition: Portfolio type label for a portfolio used to hold savings, shown alone next to Investment, Retirement and Other. It describes the portfolio.
ukNote: Adjective agreeing with «портфель».

definition: The share of income left after spending over a period, shown as a percentage in cash-flow analytics. Spending in categories marked as savings counts toward it.
Badge on a recurring payment that is due soon but not overdue yet (the other badge is 'Overdue'). Not a planned transaction, which shows 'Expected'.
ukNote: Badge form; in running text: запланований.

definition: The permissions a connected AI app was granted through OAuth ('Scope: {scopes}'), e.g. read financial data or offline access. Not the sharing write scope.
A plan-limited place for one person the user shares with: each plan caps how many people can have accepted access to one household, account or budget. Not a physical seat.
ukNote: Plan cards say 'household seats': write e.g. «{count} місць для учасників», never «місце в сім'ї» (reads as one's role in the family). Current strings still say «місце в/у домогосподарстві», while household = сім'я elsewhere.

definition: A tradable financial instrument (stock, ETF, crypto) a portfolio can hold. Not safety or protection. A holding is one security within a portfolio.
ukNote: Genitive singular: «цінного папера» (document sense), not паперу (paper as material).

definition: Safety of the user's MoneyMatter login and data: the Security settings page (password, login methods, sessions, backups) and security notes. Not a tradable instrument.
Investment transaction type: selling units of a holding for cash. Shown as a type label next to Buy, Dividend, Fee and Tax.
A signed-in period on a device, listed under Security settings; also how long a bank connection stays authorized, or how long an uploaded import file is kept on the server.
Currency of the cash actually paid or received for a trade, which can differ from the security's own currency. The form says "Payment currency", the table "Cash ccy". Not the base currency.
ukNote: 'Cash ccy' (column header) is also валюта розрахунку, not готівка.

definition: The one-time code the user creates in SimpleFIN Bridge and pastes into MoneyMatter to connect it. Where a string quotes SimpleFIN's own label, keep that label in English.
ukNote: When a string quotes SimpleFIN's own dashboard label, keep it in English inside «» (uk.md §2).

definition: A unit of a holding: stock, ETF or crypto ("Price per Share", the "Shares" column); use a neutral units word if your stock word misfits crypto. Not access given, and not a proportion.
ukNote: 'Shares' (quantity held, column label) = «кількість» (uk.md §5); per share = «за одиницю»; short unit «од.»; «акції» only where the text means stock.

definition: Access to an account, budget or household that its owner gave another user ("Leave share?", "Per-account shares"); "Sharing" is the tab that manages it. Not units held, not a proportion.
ukNote: Verb share = «поділитися» («Поділитися рахунком»). The Sharing tab = «Спільний доступ», not «Поділ». Per-account share = спільний доступ до окремого рахунку. Shared account = спільний рахунок.

definition: Give another MoneyMatter user access to your household or to one of your accounts or budgets, by invitation. Not units of a holding, and not a proportion.
ukNote: «Поділитися рахунком». 'Shared by {handle}' = «Ділиться: {handle}» (no gender agreement); «Поділено з {handle}» means shared WITH them. 'Shared with me' = «Поділилися зі мною». No passive participle: поділений means 'divided', so write «…, яким поділилися з вами» or «спільний …».

definition: A proportion of a total, e.g. "Share of income" or the GP's share of profits. Not units of a holding, and not access given to someone.
An account one user owns and has shared with another; it keeps the owner's categories and payees. Not a joint account held at a bank.
ukNote: Here: an account someone shared with you in MoneyMatter, not a bank joint account (the usual banking sense of спільний рахунок). Where that reading is possible, write «рахунок зі спільним доступом».
