definition: On plans below Plus, MoneyMatter AI requests from all such users draw on one shared usage quota, so limits may apply when overall demand is high. Upgrading to Plus takes the user off the shared pool.
Generic name for an account, budget or household shared between users, used when its type isn't named. Not the uploaded file the server keeps during an import session.
Name of the page, settings item and account-list section that list accounts, budgets and households other users shared with the current user.
Investment file import: the column giving each row's type (buy, sell, dividend, fee, tax, transfer, cancel), 'Side / Action'. Not a page side or the cash side of a trade.
Brand of a bank-data service for US and Canadian banks, connected through its SimpleFIN Bridge product. Brand name: do not translate.
SimpleFIN's paid hosted service where the user links US or Canadian banks and creates the setup token MoneyMatter needs; strings may say just "Bridge". Keep as is.
ukNote: 'bridge account' = «обліковий запис SimpleFIN Bridge»; never translate Bridge as «міст».

definition: Leave an item out without deleting it: a row or account not imported, a recurring payment period marked as not happening, or a suggestion hidden.
Status of an item left out and not processed: by the user's choice (import row, account, recurring payment period), as a duplicate, or because it couldn't be read. Not deleted.
ukNote: Status label form; as an agreeing adjective: пропущений.

definition: The highest of three model tiers in the "Which model fits?" guide: the most capable and most expensive models. Inserted as {tier} in "{tier} model is enough". Not the user-chosen AI model names like "Claude smart" in examples.
ukNote: Masculine, agreeing with the implied «рівень»: «Достатньо рівня «{tier}»».

definition: The account money leaves in a transfer, loan payment or portfolio transfer; the opposite of the destination account. Field labels say 'From account'.
ukNote: Opposite: цільовий рахунок. Source portfolio = вихідний портфель. Field label 'From account' = «З рахунку».

definition: Dashboard widget showing the period's spending split by category. Its card title is 'Expenses Structure': one widget with two English names, ideally one translation.
A large day-to-day balance change, up or down, marked on the Balance trend chart; the percent and amount thresholds that count as a spike are user settings.
A part of one transaction's amount assigned to its own category; also the act of dividing a transaction across several categories.
ukNote: One split line = частина (розподілу): «Кожна частина має мати іншу категорію». Verb on buttons ('Split into categories') = розділити; a split transaction = розділена транзакція.

definition: Special purpose vehicle: the legal entity through which a venture deal invests in one or several startups. Keep the acronym.
A bank, card or broker document (PDF, CSV, TXT, OFX/QFX) listing transactions, imported to create them in bulk. Not a claim or declaration.
The AI feature and page that reads an uploaded bank statement (PDF, CSV or TXT) and extracts its transactions for import.
ukNote: The process in prose ('statement parsing') = розбір виписок.

definition: A share of a company traded on an exchange; the Stocks asset class and search filter. For units of any holding, crypto included, see 'share'.
ukNote: Filter label: «Акції». The number of units held is «кількість», not акції.

definition: The payment company that charges cards for MoneyMatter plans and retries failed payments. Brand name: do not translate.
AI model capability badge: the model can return structured output (data in a fixed JSON format). Shown next to Text, Vision, Functions, Fast and Agents.
Status of a bank sync that stopped progressing because a bank connection didn't respond in time; the user can retry or reconnect. Not failed.
ukNote: With синхронізація: «Синхронізація зависла».

definition: A category nested under another (parent) category; categories can nest a few levels deep.
Button label that sends a form for processing.
ukNote: 'Confirm' = Підтвердити; don't reuse it for Submit. In forms that move money, where Надіслати could read as sending money, use the form's own verb (forms.directCashTransaction.submitButton opens a confirm step: «Продовжити»).

definition: The Subscription type of recurring payment (next to Bill and Installment), e.g. streaming. In prose about any recurring item it means a recurring payment.
ukNote: Where it means any recurring item ('Couldn't load your subscriptions') = регулярний платіж.

definition: The user's paid MoneyMatter plan, in billing banners and Plan & billing settings ("Your subscription has ended", "Subscribe again"). Not the Subscription recurring-payment type.
ukNote: uk.md §5: підписка for the plan too. 'Subscribe' = «оформити підписку»; 'Subscribe again' = «Підписатися знову».

definition: Venture term: the capital an investor commits to an SPV or fund, before entry fees. Not a recurring payment or a MoneyMatter plan.
Widget-picker name of the recurring-payments dashboard widget; it names two of its types, Subscription and Bill (a payment due, not an account). The widget also shows installments.
Proposed by the app, not chosen by the user: a low-confidence column match to confirm in import mapping, transactions offered as recurring-payment matches, or categories picked by AI.
ukNote: Standalone status label: «Запропоновано».

definition: Header button with a heart icon that invites users to back the MoneyMatter project, e.g. by donating. Not customer support.
MoneyMatter's help team users contact when something goes wrong ('contact support'). Not 'supports/supported' (compatibility), the header Support button (donations) or child support.
MoneyMatter's support email address. Copy it exactly.
On investment screens: a security's ticker (AAPL, BTC), same as "ticker" ("Add Symbols", the "Symbol" column). Translate the word; the codes stay. Not a currency symbol such as $.
ukNote: «символ» stays for currency symbols ($, ₴) and character counts («не більше {max} символів»).

definition: Fetching the latest accounts and transactions from a connected bank integration.
ukNote: Verb on buttons ('Sync now') = синхронізувати.

definition: In Venture: a group of investors, led by a lead or GP, who pool money into one deal, usually through an SPV (e.g. an AngelList syndicate).
A built-in category the app manages itself (e.g. Other); it can't be moved, used as a parent or hold subcategories. Not a user-created category.
A free-form label users attach to transactions for flexible, non-category grouping.
A rule on a tag that notifies the user when tagged transactions appear or when spending on the tag passes a set amount.
ukNote: Inside tag settings plain «нагадування» is enough.

definition: In a transfer between currencies, the converted amount that arrives in the destination account, portfolio or loan. Not a goal or savings target.
ukNote: Means the amount credited to the destination, not a goal. In the loan dialog, 'Amount applied to loan' follows loan = «кредит», not «позика».

definition: Venture deal field: free-text name of the startup or thesis the deal backs (e.g. 'YC W26 batch'), for display only. Not an acquisition target.
Investment transaction type recording tax withheld or paid on an investment, e.g. withholding tax on a dividend.
A saved set of transaction form values (amount, account, category, payee, tags, note) that fills the form in one tap. In imports, 'Saved templates' are saved import mappings.
The length of a loan, in months. Not 'terms' meaning the conditions of a loan or deal.
ukNote: 'terms' (conditions) = умови. термін elsewhere means a due date (термін оплати) or a word, so «Поширені терміни» reads as 'common terminology'.

definition: Built-in macOS text editor, named in the Enable Banking setup steps for opening the key file. Keep as is.
The short trading code of a stock, ETF or crypto (e.g. AAPL, BTC), same as 'symbol' on investment screens; not a currency symbol ($, ₴). Translate the word; the codes stay unchanged.
ukNote: Symbol (security) = тікер too, not символ (see symbol).

definition: A chronological view: a loan's or venture deal's event history, the over-time tab in budget statistics, or the date strip in statement import. Not a project plan.
ukNote: 'Transaction Timeline' in statement import is also «Хронологія транзакцій».

definition: In AI features: the unit of text an AI model reads and writes, used to measure file size and cost ('Estimated tokens'). Not an access token.
A secret code that gives MoneyMatter or a connected app access: a Monobank API token, a SimpleFIN setup token, OAuth access tokens. Not an AI token.
ukNote: Monobank 'API token' = «API-токен»; SimpleFIN 'setup token': see setup token.

definition: On a payee: the category used most often in its transactions, applied when no default category is set. Not a top-level category or a split's main category.
The root of the category tree. A top-level category has no parent category; dropping a category there takes it out of its parent.
A portfolio's overall investment performance, combining realized and unrealized gains. An investment return, not a refund of money.
Current worth of a whole portfolio: market value of all holdings plus cash. Not total cost (what was paid for the holdings).
ukNote: 'Total Cost' in the holdings table (portfolioDetail.holdingsTable.headers.totalCost) is currently also «Загальна вартість», although it is the summed cost basis (базова вартість, uk.md §5).

definition: A user-created watcher of spending over a date range against an optional limit; it holds transactions added by hand or matched by category. Not the budget (the period-based plan).
ukNote: Masculine: трекера, трекеру, трекером, у трекері; plural трекери, трекерів.

definition: One buy or sell of a security in a portfolio. Its cash side may settle in another currency (the settlement currency). Not a venture deal.
A single recorded money movement: an expense, income or transfer; in portfolios also a buy, sell or cash transaction.
A user-made bundle of related transactions shown together, with its own name, note and totals (e.g. one trip). UI often says just 'Group'. Not an account group.
ukNote: Short labels 'Group'/'Groups' (navigation.transactionGroups): «група»/«групи». Account groups: «група рахунків».

definition: A transaction moving money between two of the user's own accounts or portfolios. Not a payment to someone else. The payment method 'Bank Transfer' is a bank wire, a different sense.
ukNote: Verb: переказати. The payment type 'Bank Transfer' (common.paymentTypes.bankTransfer) is «Банківський переказ», a different sense.

definition: One side of a transfer: the outgoing or the incoming transaction. If the other side isn't imported, the leg is kept alone as an out-of-wallet transaction.
Finding an expense and an income that are really one transfer between the user's own accounts, and linking them. Name of an Optimizations tool and a setting.
ukNote: 'Transfer suggestions' (the candidate pairs found, not the process) = «пропозиції переказів».

definition: Holding area on the Investments page for deleted portfolios: they can be restored for 30 days, then are permanently deleted. Venture delete messages also point to it. A recycle bin.
ukNote: Button 'Move to Trash' = «Перемістити у смітник».

definition: Analytics report comparing spending, income and savings for a selected period against the previous period.
The free period after signup with Plus-plan features unlocked (backup restore excluded). When it ends, data stays viewable and exportable but read-only until the user subscribes.
A vehicle's trim level: the equipment version of a make and model (e.g. 'Sport', 'Base'). Field of a vehicle asset. Not the verb 'trim' (cut).
Venture metric Total Value to Paid-In: distributions received plus current value, divided by the capital paid in. Keep the acronym.
Short for 'transaction' in tight labels. '# tx' and 'Tx amount' both mean the number of transactions, not a sum of money; '(no tx)' means without a transaction.
ukNote: In narrow columns abbreviate the count word, not «транзакції»: «К-ть транзакцій». 'Tx amount' = кількість транзакцій, not a sum.

definition: Plain-text file format, accepted for bank statements and investment imports. Keep as is.
Return an archived account, budget or loan to the active lists and pickers. Opposite of archive. Some loan screens say "Restore" for the same action.
Describes a transaction with no real category yet: none set, or still in the user's default fallback category. AI categorization works on these.
ukNote: Standalone label without a noun: «Без категорії».

definition: Badge on a pending planned transaction over a week past its date with no matching bank transaction; the user must confirm it happened. Otherwise the badge is 'Expected'.
ukNote: Badge form; the sibling badge is «Очікується».

definition: Remove a link without deleting anything: between a transfer's sides, a refund and its expense, a transaction and a budget/portfolio/loan/recurring payment, or an account and its bank.
Describes an import row whose currency has no stored exchange rate, so it can't be converted to the base currency. About exchange rates, not item prices.
Gain or loss on holdings still owned: current market value minus cost basis, not yet locked in by selling. Can be negative.
Describes payments due soon: the pinned section of overdue and soon-due scheduled payments, or a future payment period. Use a word distinct from "planned" (scheduled).
ukNote: Section title: «Найближчі». Status of a payment period that hasn't started yet (planned.subscriptions.periods.status.upcoming): «майбутній».

definition: Move to a higher MoneyMatter plan to unlock features ('Upgrade to Plus'). Not a software update.
ukNote: 'Upgrade to Plus' = «перейти на Plus».

definition: A web address: an MCP server URL, an AI model's base URL, a transaction's external link, a bank redirect URL. Keep the acronym.
ukNote: «URL-адреса» where grammar needs a noun. A transaction's External URL field is shown as «Зовнішнє посилання».

definition: Share of a limit already used: of a budget's limit spent so far (Budget Utilization), or of credit card limits (Credit Utilization widget).
ukNote: Credit Utilization = «Використання кредитного ліміту», not «Використання кредиту» (кредит = loan); see credit utilization.

definition: A manual correction of a vehicle's current value, saved as a dated entry that restarts depreciation from there. Elsewhere 'override' just means replacing a default.
ukNote: Short labels just «корекція» («Остання корекція», «Історія корекцій»). Verb: скоригувати (вартість). Outside vehicles 'override' = перевизначити/змінити/перезаписати, not «корекція».

definition: A car or other vehicle tracked as an asset, with its own account and a value that depreciates over time. Not the Vehicle loan type (car loan) or the car-costs category.
ukNote: «транспорт» is a mass noun: one asset is «транспортний засіб» («Транспортний засіб додано», «Видалити транспортний засіб?»). Section, account-category and nav labels (accounts.sections.vehicles, common.accountCategories.vehicle, sidebar 'Cars') stay «Транспорт». Loan type Vehicle = «Автокредит»; seeded category = «Авто».

definition: Seeded expense category for car costs (fuel, parking, insurance, maintenance). Use your market's natural category name. Not the vehicle asset account.
The kind of vehicle (sedan, SUV, truck, luxury, electric, motorcycle...) that sets its default depreciation curve. Shown alone as "Class". Not only a body type, and not an asset class.
ukNote: Follows vehicle = транспортний засіб. Standalone 'Class' = «Тип».

definition: The section for private venture investments (SPVs, syndicates, fund deals), separate from Investments. Use a real word that differs from the Investments label.
ukNote: Plural 'Ventures' = «Венчури» (uk.md §5).

definition: One private investment in the Venture section: a single SPV, syndicate or fund commitment with its own events. UI often says just 'deal'. Not a discount.
ukNote: uk.md §5, backend too. Bare 'deal' = угода.

definition: A dated entry on a venture deal: initial investment, capital call, distribution, NAV update, exit, writedown or fee payment. The UI says just 'event'.
ukNote: In the Venture UI just «подія».

definition: A saved set of layout and filters on the Pivot analytics page, or a display mode (List view, Table view). Not the verb 'view' and not a screen.
AI model capability label: the model can read images such as receipts or scanned statements. Shown with Text, Structured, Functions, Fast, Agents.
Environment variable a self-hosting admin sets to turn on brand logos. Code name: copy it exactly.
A Microsoft Money entry marked void: kept in the register but never applied to the balance. Imported at zero with the tag "Void", which stays in English.
ukNote: Keep the tag «Void» in English.

definition: A place money is kept outside a bank account: a cash or e-wallet, or a per-currency balance at a provider such as Walutomat. In "out of wallet" it means the tracked accounts. Not the Wallet app.
ukNote: Out of wallet = «поза гаманцем», also in the Wallet (BudgetBakers) import.

definition: Wallet by BudgetBakers, a third-party budgeting app whose export MoneyMatter imports; lists may say just "Wallet". Brand name: do not translate.
ukNote: 'Out of wallet' in the Wallet import is not the brand: «Поза гаманцем» (uk.md §5), not «Поза Wallet».

definition: Polish currency-exchange platform; a provider the user connects to import its currency wallets. Brand name: do not translate.
Dashboard widget that tracks spending and income for categories the user picks, like a stock watchlist. A widget name, not a to-do list.
ukNote: Widget name: «Спостереження за категоріями» (sentence case; спостереження за + instrumental, as in «Спостереження за продуктами»).

definition: Image file format, accepted for transaction attachments and invoices. Keep as is.
Microsoft's operating system, named in the Enable Banking setup steps. Brand name: do not translate.
Permanently erase all of the user's financial data while keeping the login, so they start over from onboarding. Not deleting the account.
Cash taken out of a portfolio's cash balance. Opposite of a deposit. Not leaving a household or a share.
All of a user's MoneyMatter data plus its settings (currencies, categories, payees, AI). Names a settings group and what 'Wipe all data' erases.
ukNote: Write it in full: робочий простір («у вашому робочому просторі»).

definition: Sharing permission between Read and Manage: on accounts and households the person can add and edit transactions (see write scope); on budgets they attach their own transactions. Not the verb.
ukNote: Follows the Read/Write label decision under read-only; current labels say «Запис», which also renders entry (запис). The account and budget dialogs spell the right out instead.

definition: For write access, which transactions the shared person may edit: all of them (on the shared account, or on any account for a household share) or only the ones they created.
ukNote: The account dialog's 'Transaction edit scope' = «Область редагування транзакцій».

definition: Venture event that lowers a deal's value with no cash moving (e.g. an impairment). A writedown to zero makes the deal written off.
ukNote: A writedown can go to zero; the deal then gets the status «Списаний». «Списання» stays for card charges (charge).

definition: Venture deal status: the investment counts as a total loss, its value written down to zero.
ukNote: Status label «Списаний» (adjective, like «Активний»), not «Списано».

definition: Y Combinator, a startup accelerator, used in venture examples. 'YC W26 batch' is its Winter 2026 group of startups. Keep 'YC'; 'batch' is translatable.
ukNote: Translate the word batch; «YC batch'у» in venture.deals.form.subtypeHint mixes languages.

definition: YNAB (You Need A Budget), a third-party budgeting app whose CSV export MoneyMatter imports. Brand name: do not translate.
Compressed archive file format (.zip) used for backups and the data export. Keep the name; 'unzip' (extract the archive) is an ordinary verb and is translated.
ukNote: unzip = «розпакувати».
